description: This file contains unit tests for utility functions related to tenant management, including functions like normalizeTenantId, fetchSessionTenants, selectTenant, setActiveTenant, and getActiveTenant.

methods.name: normalizeTenantId
methods.description: Normalizes various tenant identifier formats into a string or null.

methods.name: fetchSessionTenants
methods.description: Fetches tenant session data from the server and returns an array of tenants.

methods.name: selectTenant
methods.description: Selects a tenant, updates local storage, and makes a server request.

methods.name: setActiveTenant
methods.description: Stores the active tenant ID in local storage, replacing legacy keys.

methods.name: getActiveTenant
methods.description: Retrieves the currently active tenant ID from local storage.
